rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Employment Insurance Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Employment Insurance Act and its Enforcement Decree, and matters necessary for their implementation.

rows.source_ko: Article 1-2 (Application for Enrollment or Withdrawal from Employment Insurance for Workers in Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries) ① An employer of a business in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries (hereinafter referred to as “agriculture, forestry, and fisheries”) who is not a corporation and employs four or fewer workers on a regular basis shall confirm the intention of the worker employed by him/her (hereinafter referred to as “agriculture, forestry, and fisheries worker”) to enroll in employment insurance (hereinafter referred to as “insurance”) in accordance with the proviso to Article 3, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Employment Insurance Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), and if it is confirmed that there is an intention to enroll, he/she shallsubmit the application for enrollment in employment insurance for workers in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, in the form of Annex No. 1, for the relevant worker to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Workers' Welfare Service”) pursuant to Article 10 of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act . However,in cases where a person who intends to subscribe to insurance pursuant to the proviso of Article 3, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is a daily worker, they must submit the Confirmation of Work Details Report in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form by the deadline for submitting the Confirmation of Work Details Report pursuant to the latter part of Article 7 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Application for Enrollment or Withdrawal from Employment Insurance for Workers in Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries) ① An employer of a business in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries (hereinafter referred to as “agriculture, forestry, and fisheries”) who is not a corporation and employs four or fewer workers on a regular basis shall confirm the intention of the worker employed by him/her (hereinafter referred to as “agriculture, forestry, and fisheries worker”) to enroll in employment insurance (hereinafter referred to as “insurance”) in accordance with the proviso to Article 3, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Employment Insurance Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), and if it is confirmed that there is an intention to enroll, he/she shall submit the application for enrollment in employment insurance for workers in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, in the form of Annex No. 1, for the relevant worker to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Workers' Welfare Service”) pursuant to Article 10 of the Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance Act. However, in cases where a person who intends to subscribe to insurance pursuant to the proviso of Article 3, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is a daily worker, they must submit the Confirmation of Work Details Report in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form by the deadline for submitting the Confirmation of Work Details Report pursuant to the latter part of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree.

rows.source_ko: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if an agricultural, forestry, or fishery worker wishes to apply for insurance coverage directly, they must submit to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service an application for employment insurance coverage for agricultural, forestry, or fishery workers in Form No. 1 (including a report confirming work details in Form No. 7 in the case of a daily worker ), along with documents proving the employment relationship, such as an employment contract.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if an agricultural, forestry, or fishery worker wishes to apply for insurance coverage directly, they must submit to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service an application for employment insurance coverage for agricultural, forestry, or fishery workers in Form No. 1 (including a report confirming work details in Form No. 7 in the case of a daily worker ), along with documents proving the employment relationship, such as an employment contract.

rows.source_ko: ③ In the event that an application for insurance coverage is made pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, the relevant agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the day following the date of application. However, if the relevant agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker is a daily worker, the worker shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the date the cause for coverage occurred.
rows.text_en: ③ In the event that an application for insurance coverage is made pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, the relevant agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the day following the date of application. However, if the relevant agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker is a daily worker, the worker shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the date the cause for coverage occurred.

rows.source_ko: ④ If an agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker enrolled in insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance, they must submit the Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance for Agricultural, Forestry, and Fisheries Workers (Form No. 1) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. In this case, the insured status shall be deemed to have been lost on the day following the date of application for withdrawal.
rows.text_en: ④ If an agricultural, forestry, or fisheries worker enrolled in insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance, they must submit the Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance for Agricultural, Forestry, and Fisheries Workers (Form No. 1) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. In this case, the insured status shall be deemed to have been lost on the day following the date of application for withdrawal.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The Korea Workers' Welfare Service, upon receiving an application for insurance enrollment or withdrawal pursuant to Paragraphs 1, 2, and 4, shall verify the applicant’s resident registration abstract through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant must be required to attach the document.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving an application for insurance enrollment or withdrawal under paragraphs 1, 2, or 4, the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service shall verify the applicant’s abstract of resident registration through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act. If the applicant does not consent to verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the document.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의3(별정직ㆍ임기제 공무원의 보험 가입ㆍ탈퇴 신청) ① 영 제3조의2제1항에 따른 소속기관(이하 “소속기관”이라 한다)의 장이나 별정직 또는 임기제 공무원(이하 “가입대상 공무원”이라 한다)이 영 제3조의2제2항에 따라 보험 가입을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의2서식의 별정직ㆍ임기제 공무원 고용보험 가입 신청서에 가입대상 공무원의 재직증명서를 첨부하여 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 30., 2016. 11. 17., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 1-3 (Applications for Enrollment in or Withdrawal from Insurance by Special-Service and Fixed-Term Public Officials) ① Where the head of an affiliated agency under Article 3-2 (1) of the Decree (hereinafter referred to as an “affiliated agency”) or a special-service or fixed-term public official (hereinafter referred to as a “public official eligible for enrollment”) applies for enrollment under Article 3-2 (2) of the Decree, the applicant shall submit an application using Attached Form No. 1-2, together with the public official’s certificate of employment, to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service. <Amended Dec. 30, 2013; Nov. 17, 2016; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 보험에 가입한 공무원이 영 제3조의2제4항에 따라 보험에서 탈퇴하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의2서식의 별정직ㆍ임기제 공무원 고용보험 가입탈퇴 신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 30., 2016. 11. 17., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② If a public official enrolled in insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, they must submit the Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance for Special and Fixed-Term Public Officials (Form No. 1-2) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. <Amended Dec. 30, 2013; Nov. 17, 2016; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 신청서를 받은 근로복지공단은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 주민등록표 초본을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2016. 11. 17., 2018. 5. 8., 2023. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, the Korea Workers' Welfare Service shall verify the applicant's abstract of resident registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant document. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; Nov. 17, 2016; May 8, 2018; Jun. 30, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(외국인근로자 등의 고용보험 가입ㆍ탈퇴 신청) ① 사업주나 하수급인[「고용보험 및 산업재해보상보험의 보험료징수 등에 관한 법률」(이하 “고용산재보험료징수법”이라 한다. 이하 같다) 제9조에 따라 원수급인이 사업주로 된 사업의 하수급인을 말한다. 이하 같다]은 그가 사용하고 있는 다음 각 호에 해당하는 외국인(이하 이 조 및 제10조에서 “외국인근로자등”이라 한다)이 「고용보험법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제10조의2제1항 단서 및 영 제3조의3제2호에 따라 보험에 가입하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의3서식의 외국인 고용보험 가입 신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 가입신청을 한 날의 다음 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다. <개정 2008. 4. 30., 2016. 11. 17., 2019. 7. 16., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applications for Enrollment in or Withdrawal from Employment Insurance by Foreign Workers, etc.) ① Where an employer or subcontractor [meaning a subcontractor of a business for which the prime contractor is deemed the employer under Article 9 of the Act on the Collection of Insurance Premiums, etc. for Employment Insurance and Industrial Accident Compensation Insurance (hereinafter referred to as the “Insurance Premium Collection Act”; hereinafter the same applies)] seeks to enroll a foreign worker employed by the employer or subcontractor who falls under any of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as a “foreign worker, etc.” in this Article and Article 10) under the proviso to Article 10-2 (1) of the Employment Insurance Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Article 3-3 (2) of the Decree, the employer or subcontractor shall submit an application for employment insurance enrollment for foreign workers using Attached Form No. 1-3 to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service. The worker shall be deemed to acquire insured status on the day following the application date. <Amended Apr. 30, 2008; Nov. 17, 2016; Jul. 16, 2019; Jul. 1, 2021; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제10조의2제1항 본문에 따른 외국인근로자
rows.text_en: 1. Foreign workers pursuant to the main text of Article 10-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제3조의3제2호에 따른 외국인
rows.text_en: 2. Foreigners pursuant to Article 3-3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 사업주나 하수급인은 법 제10조의2제1항 단서 및 영 제3조의3제2호에 따라 보험에 가입하려는 사람이 일용근로자인 경우에는 영 제7조제1항 후단에 따른 근로내용 확인신고서 제출 기한까지 별지 제1호의3서식의 외국인 고용보험 가입 신청서와 별지 제7호서식의 근로내용 확인신고서를 제출할 수 있다. 이 경우 그 가입의 사유가 발생한 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다. <신설 2008. 4. 30., 2019. 7. 16., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if the person intending to enroll in insurance pursuant to the proviso to Paragraph 1 of Article 10-2 of the Act and Subparagraph 2 of Article 3-3 of the Enforcement Decree is a daily worker, an employer or subcontractor may submit the Application for Enrollment in Foreign Employment Insurance ( Form No. 1-3) and the Report on Confirmation of Work Details ( Form No. 7) by the deadline for submitting the Report on Confirmation of Work Details pursuant to the latter part of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree. In this case, the insured status shall be deemed to have been acquired on the date the cause for enrollment occurred. <Newly added Apr. 30, 2008; Jul. 16, 2019; Jul. 1, 2021; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 사업주나 하수급인은 보험에 가입한 외국인근로자등이 보험에서 탈퇴하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의3서식의 고용보험 가입탈퇴 신청서를 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 가입탈퇴 신청을 한 날의 다음날에 피보험자격을 상실한 것으로 본다. <신설 2008. 4. 30., 2018. 7. 11., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ If a foreign worker, etc. enrolled in insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance, the employer or subcontractor must submit an Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance in accordance with Form No. 1-3 of the Attached Register. In this case, the insured status shall be deemed to have been lost on the day following the date of the application for withdrawal. <Newly added Apr. 30, 2008; Jul. 11, 2018; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 신청서를 받은 근로복지공단은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 「출입국관리법」 제88조에 따른 외국인등록 사실증명을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 4. 30., 2011. 1. 3., 2016. 11. 17., 2023. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Korea Workers' Welfare Service, upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2, shall verify the certificate of alien registration pursuant to Article 88 of the Immigration Control Act through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Amended Apr. 30, 2008; Jan. 3, 2011; Nov. 17, 2016; Jun. 30, 2023>
[Title amended June 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(외국인예술인의 보험 가입ㆍ탈퇴 신청) ① 법 제10조의2제2항에 따른 외국인 중 법 제77조의2제1항에 따른 예술인(이하 이 조에서 “외국인예술인”이라 한다)과 법 제77조의2제1항에 따른 문화예술용역 관련 계약(이하 “문화예술용역 관련 계약”이라 한다)을 체결한 사업주(법 제77조의2제3항에 해당하는 경우에는 그 발주자 또는 원수급인을 말한다. 이하 이 조, 제6조 및 제125조의3에서 같다)가 영 제3조의3제4호에 따라 보험 가입을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식의 외국인예술인 고용보험 가입신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. 다만, 해당 외국인예술인이 법 제77조의2제2항제2호 단서에 따른 단기예술인(이하 “단기예술인”이라 한다)인 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식의 외국인예술인 고용보험 가입신청서와 별지 제7호의2서식의 노무제공내용 확인신고서를 그 사유가 발생한 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달 15일까지 제출해야 한다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Applications for Enrollment in or Withdrawal from Employment Insurance by Foreign Artists) ① Where an employer has entered into a contract for cultural and artistic services under Article 77-2 (1) of the Act with an artist under Article 77-2 (1) of the Act who is a foreign national under Article 10-2 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a “foreign artist” in this Article), or, in cases under Article 77-2 (3), where the client or prime contractor (hereinafter the same applies in this Article, Article 6 and Article 125-3), seeks enrollment under Article 3-3 (4) of the Decree, that employer, client or prime contractor shall submit the Application for Enrollment in Employment Insurance for Foreign Artists using Attached Form No. 1-4 to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service. However, where the foreign artist is a short-term artist under the proviso to Article 77-2 (2) 2 of the Act, the Application using Attached Form No. 1-4 and the Report on Confirmation of Labor Provision using Attached Form No. 7-2 shall be submitted by the 15th of the month following the month in which the relevant event occurred. <Amended Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 외국인예술인이 직접 보험 가입을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식의 외국인예술인 고용보험 가입신청서(단기예술인인 경우에는 별지 제7호의2서식의 노무제공내용 확인신고서를 포함한다)에 계약서 등 문화예술용역 관련 계약 관계를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if a foreign artist wishes to apply for insurance enrollment directly, they must submit the Application for Employment Insurance for Foreign Artists ( Form No. 1-4) (including the Report on Confirmation of Labor Provision (Form No. 7-2 ) in the case of short-term artists ) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service, attaching documents proving contractual relationships related to cultural and artistic services, such as contracts. <Amended July 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 보험 가입을 신청한 외국인예술인은 가입을 신청한 날의 다음 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다. 다만, 해당 외국인예술인이 단기예술인인 경우에는 문화예술용역 관련 계약에 따라 노무를 제공한 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ A foreign artist who has applied for insurance coverage pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the day following the date of application. However, if the said foreign artist is a short-term artist, they shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the date they provided labor in accordance with a contract related to cultural and artistic services.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보험에 가입한 외국인예술인이 보험에서 탈퇴하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식의 고용보험 가입탈퇴 신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 탈퇴를 신청한 날의 다음 날에 피보험자격을 상실한 것으로 본다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ If a foreign artist enrolled in the insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance, they must submit an Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance ( Form No. 1-4) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. In this case, the artist shall be deemed to have lost their insured status on the day following the date of the application for withdrawal. <Amended July 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항, 제2항 및 제4항에 따라 보험 가입 또는 탈퇴 신청을 받은 근로복지공단은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 「출입국관리법」 제88조제2항에 따른 외국인등록 사실증명을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Korea Workers' Welfare Service, upon receiving an application for insurance enrollment or withdrawal pursuant to Paragraphs 1, 2, and 4, shall verify the certificate of foreigner registration pursuant to Article 88, Paragraph 2 of the Immigration Control Act through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant must be required to attach the relevant documents.

[This Article was newly added on June 30, 2023.]
[Formerly Article 2-2 was moved to Article 1-2 <June 30, 2023>]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의3(외국인노무제공자의 보험 가입ㆍ탈퇴 신청) ① 법 제10조의2제2항에 따른 외국인 중 법 제77조의6제1항에 따른 노무제공자(이하 이 조에서 “외국인노무제공자”라 한다)와 법 제77조의6제1항에 따른 노무제공계약(이하 “노무제공계약”이라 한다)을 체결한 사업의 사업주(이하 “노무제공사업의 사업주”라 한다) 및 법 제77조의7제1항에 따른 노무제공플랫폼사업자(이하 “노무제공플랫폼사업자”라 한다)가 영 제3조의3제4호에 따라 보험 가입을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의5서식의 외국인노무제공자 고용보험 가입신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. 다만, 해당 외국인노무제공자가 법 제77조의6제2항제2호 단서에 따른 단기노무제공자(이하 “단기노무제공자”라 한다)인 경우에는 별지 제1호의5서식의 외국인노무제공자 고용보험 가입신청서와 별지 제7호의2서식의 노무제공내용 확인신고서를 그 사유가 발생한 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달 15일까지 제출해야 한다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Applications for Enrollment in or Withdrawal from Employment Insurance by Foreign Labor Providers) ① Where the employer of a business that has entered into a labor provision contract under Article 77-6 (1) of the Act with a person who is a foreign national under Article 10-2 (2) of the Act and a labor provider under Article 77-6 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a “foreign labor provider” in this Article), or a labor provision platform business operator under Article 77-7 (1) of the Act, seeks insurance enrollment under Article 3-3 (4) of the Decree, the employer or platform operator shall submit the Application for Enrollment in Employment Insurance for Foreign Labor Providers using Attached Form No. 1-5 to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service. The term “labor provision contract” refers to a contract under Article 77-6 (1), and the employer of such a business is referred to as the “employer of the labor provision business.” However, if the foreign labor provider is a short-term labor provider under the proviso to Article 77-6 (2) 2 of the Act, the Application using Attached Form No. 1-5 and the Report on Confirmation of Labor Provision using Attached Form No. 7-2 shall be submitted by the 15th day of the month following the month in which the relevant event occurred. <Amended Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 외국인노무제공자가 직접 보험 가입을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의5서식의 외국인노무제공자 고용보험 가입신청서(단기노무제공자인 경우에는 별지 제7호의2서식의 노무제공내용 확인신고서를 포함한다)에 계약서 등 노무제공계약 관계를 증명할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if a foreign service provider intends to apply for insurance enrollment directly, they must submit the Application for Employment Insurance Enrollment for Foreign Service Providers ( Form No. 1-5) (including the Report on Confirmation of Service Provision Details (Form No. 7-2 ) in the case of a short-term service provider) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service, attaching documents proving the contractual relationship regarding the provision of labor, such as a contract. <Amended July 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 보험 가입을 신청한 경우 해당 외국인노무제공자는 가입을 신청한 날의 다음 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다. 다만, 해당 외국인노무제공자가 단기노무제공자인 경우에는 노무제공계약에 따라 노무를 제공한 날에 피보험자격을 취득한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ Where a foreign labor provider applies for insurance enrollment under paragraphs 1 and 2, the provider shall be deemed to have acquired insured status on the day after the date of application. For a short-term foreign labor provider, insured status shall be deemed acquired on the date on which labor is provided under the labor provision contract.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보험에 가입한 외국인노무제공자가 보험에서 탈퇴하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호의5서식의 고용보험 가입탈퇴 신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 탈퇴를 신청한 날의 다음 날에 피보험자격을 상실한 것으로 본다. <개정 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ If a foreign service provider enrolled in insurance wishes to withdraw from the insurance, they must submit an Application for Withdrawal from Employment Insurance (Form No. 1-5) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. In this case, the insured status shall be deemed to have been lost on the day following the date of the application for withdrawal. <Amended July 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항, 제2항 및 제4항에 따라 보험 가입 또는 탈퇴 신청을 받은 근로복지공단은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 「출입국관리법」 제88조제2항에 따른 외국인등록 사실증명을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Korea Workers' Welfare Service, upon receiving an application for insurance enrollment or withdrawal pursuant to Paragraphs 1, 2, and 4, shall verify the certificate of foreigner registration pursuant to Article 88, Paragraph 2 of the Immigration Control Act through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant must be required to attach the relevant documents.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(대리인 선임 또는 해임의 신고) 영 제4조제2항에 따른 대리인 선임이나 해임의 신고는 별지 제2호서식의 대리인 선임ㆍ해임 신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Reporting of Appointment or Dismissal of Agent) The report of appointment or dismissal of an agent pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Report on Appointment or Dismissal of Agent in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제2장 피보험자 관리
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Management of Insured Persons

rows.source_ko: 제4조(원수급인의 하수급인에 관한 자료 제출) ① 법 제15조제2항 각 호 외의 부분 후단에 따라 원수급인이 하수급인에 관한 자료를 제출하려면 하도급계약을 체결한 날부터 14일 이내에 별지 제3호서식의 하수급인 명세서에 하도급계약서 사본과 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 등록증 사본을 첨부하여 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2016. 11. 17., 2022. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Submission of Information on Subcontractors by Prime Contractors) ① A prime contractor submitting information on subcontractors under the latter part of Article 15 (2) of the Act, excluding the subparagraphs, shall submit a statement of subcontractors using Attached Form No. 3, together with a copy of the subcontract and a copy of the registration certificate specified in the following subparagraphs, to the Korea Workers’ Compensation and Welfare Service within 14 days after the subcontract is concluded. <Amended Nov. 17, 2016; Jun. 30, 2022; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「건설산업기본법」에 따른 건설사업자: 같은 법 제9조의2제1항에 따른 건설업 등록증
rows.text_en: 1. Construction business operator pursuant to the Framework Act on the Construction Industry: Construction business registration certificate pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 1 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「주택법」 제4조에 따른 주택건설사업자: 같은 법 시행령 제15조제2항에 따른 주택건설사업자 등록증
rows.text_en: 2. Housing construction business operator pursuant to Article 4 of the Housing Act: Housing construction business operator registration certificate pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「전기공사업법」에 따른 공사업자: 같은 법 제4조제4항에 따른 전기공사업 등록증
rows.text_en: 3. Contractor under the Electric Construction Business Act: Electric construction business registration certificate pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 4 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「정보통신공사업법」에 따른 정보통신공사업자: 같은 법 제14조제3항에 따른 정보통신공사업 등록증
rows.text_en: 4. Information and communications construction business operator pursuant to the Information and Communications Construction Business Act: Information and communications construction business registration certificate pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「소방시설공사업법」에 따른 소방시설업자: 같은 법 제4조제3항에 따른 소방시설업 등록증
rows.text_en: 5. Firefighting facility business operator pursuant to the Firefighting Facilities Construction Business Act: Firefighting facility business registration certificate pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 3 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 「국가유산수리 등에 관한 법률」 제14조에 따른 국가유산수리업자등: 같은 법 제14조제7항에 따른 국가유산수리업등 등록증
rows.text_en: 6. National Heritage Repair Contractor, etc. pursuant to Article 14 of the Act on the Repair, etc. of National Heritage: Registration Certificate for National Heritage Repair Business, etc. pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 7 of the same Act

rows.source_ko: ② 근로복지공단은 제1항에 따른 하수급인 명세서를 받으면 하수급인관리번호 등을 적은 별지 제4호서식의 하수급인 확인서를 원수급인과 하수급인에게 각각 내주어야 한다. <개정 2016. 11. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving the subcontractor details pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Korea Workers' Welfare Service shall issue a Subcontractor Confirmation Certificate in the form of Annex 4, containing the subcontractor management number, etc., to the prime contractor and the subcontractor, respectively. <Amended Nov. 17, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실신고 등) ① 영 제7조제1항 전단 및 같은 조 제2항에 따라 사업주나 하수급인이 근로자의 피보험자격의 취득 또는 상실에 관한 사항을 신고하려면 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 신고서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2008. 4. 30., 2016. 11. 17., 2020. 12. 10., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 ( Reporting of Acquisition or Loss of Insured Status, etc. ) ① In accordance with the first part of Article 7, Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, if an employer or a subcontractor wishes to report matters concerning the acquisition or loss of an employee's insured status, they shall submit a report form, as classified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. <Amended Apr. 30, 2008; Nov. 17, 2016; Dec. 10, 2020; Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 피보험자격의 취득의 경우 : 별지 제5호서식의 고용보험 근로자 피보험자격취득 신고서
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of acquiring insured status: Report on Acquisition of Employment Insurance Worker Insured Status (Form No. 5)

rows.source_ko: 2. 피보험자격의 상실의 경우 : 별지 제6호서식의 고용보험 근로자 피보험자격상실 신고서
rows.text_en: 2. In case of loss of insured status: Report on Loss of Employment Insurance Worker Insured Status (Form No. 6)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제7조제1항 후단에 따른 일용근로자의 근로내용 확인신고서는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다. <신설 2008. 4. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The report confirming the details of work for daily workers pursuant to the latter part of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form. <Newly added Apr. 30, 2008>
③ Deleted <2020. 8. 28.>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제8조에 따라 근로자가 피보험자격의 취득과 상실 등에 관한 사항을 신고하려면 별지 제10호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 신고서를 근로복지공단에 제출해야 한다. <개정 2008. 4. 30., 2016. 11. 17., 2020. 12. 10., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ In accordance with Article 8 of the Enforcement Decree, if a worker wishes to report matters concerning the acquisition and loss of insured status, etc., he/she must submit the Employment Insurance Insured Status Report (Form No. 10) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. <Amended Apr. 30, 2008; Nov. 17, 2016; Dec. 10, 2020; Jul. 1, 2021>
[Title amended Apr. 30, 2008]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(피보험자격 취득ㆍ상실 신고 결과의 통지) ①근로복지공단은 법 제15조제1항부터 제3항까지, 영 제3조제3항제2호 단서ㆍ제3조의2제2항ㆍ제4항 및 이 규칙 제1조의2제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제4항, 제2조제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제3항, 제2조의2제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제4항, 제2조의3제1항ㆍ제2항ㆍ제4항에 따라 신고 또는 신청 받은 사항을 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 사업주, 노무제공사업의 사업주, 노무제공플랫폼사업자, 소속기관의 장 및 피보험자에게 문서(전자문서를 포함한다)로 각각 알려야 한다. <개정 2015. 7. 1., 2016. 11. 17., 2018. 12. 31., 2023. 6. 30., 2024. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notification of Results of Reports of Acquisition or Loss of Insured Status) ① The Korea Workers' Compensation and Welfare Service shall notify the employers, employers of labor provision businesses, labor provision platform operators, heads of affiliated agencies, and insured persons, respectively, in writing (including by electronic document), of reports and applications received pursuant to Article 15 (1) through (3) of the Act; the proviso to Article 3 (3) 2 and Article 3-2 (2) and (4) of the Decree; and Article 1-2 (1), (2), and (4), Article 2 (1) through (3), Article 2-2 (1), (2), and (4), and Article 2-3 (1), (2), and (4) of this Rule, using the forms prescribed below. <Amended Jul. 1, 2015; Nov. 17, 2016; Dec. 31, 2018; Jun. 30, 2023; Jul. 1, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업주, 노무제공사업의 사업주, 노무제공플랫폼사업자 또는 소속기관의 장에게는 별지 제11호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 취득ㆍ상실 신고명세 통지서(일용근로자를 사용하는 사업주에게는 별지 제12호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 신고명세 통지서)
rows.text_en: 1. For employers, employers of labor provision businesses, labor provision platform operators, and heads of affiliated agencies: Notice of Details of Reported Acquisition or Loss of Employment Insurance Insured Status using Attached Form No. 11 (or, for employers of daily workers, Notice of Details of Reported Employment Insurance Insured Status using Attached Form No. 12)

rows.source_ko: 2. 피보험자에게는 별지 제13호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 취득ㆍ상실 신고사실 통지서(일용근로자의 경우는 별지 제14호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 신고사실 통지서)
rows.text_en: 2. For insured persons: Notice of the Fact of Reporting Acquisition or Loss of Employment Insurance Insured Status using Attached Form No. 13 (or, for daily workers, Notice of the Fact of Reporting Employment Insurance Insured Status using Attached Form No. 14)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제1호에도 불구하고 근로복지공단은 사업주가 제7조에 따라 정보통신망을 활용하여 피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실 신고를 하고 그 결과를 확인할 수 있는 경우에는 해당 사업주에게 그 신고 결과의 통지를 생략할 수 있다. <신설 2015. 7. 1., 2016. 11. 17.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, the Korea Workers' Welfare Service may omit notification of the results of a report to the relevant employer if the employer has reported the acquisition or loss of insured status using an information and communications network pursuant to Article 7 and the results can be verified. <Newly added July 1, 2015; November 17, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(전자적 방법에 따른 신고) 법 제15조제5항에 따라 사업주ㆍ원수급인 또는 하수급인은 고용노동부장관이 설치ㆍ운영하는 정보통신망을 활용하여 피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실에 관한 신고를 할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2015. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Reporting by Electronic Means) Pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 5 of the Act, an employer, prime contractor, or subcontractor may report the acquisition or loss of insured status by utilizing an information and communications network established and operated by the Minister of Employment and Labor. <Amended July 12, 2010; July 1, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(전자적 방법에 따른 신고의 지원) ① 법 제15조제6항에 따라 고용노동부장관은 전자적 방법으로 피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실에 관한 사항을 신고하려는 사업주ㆍ원수급인이나 하수급인에게 예산의 범위에서 다음 각 호의 장비를 지원할 수 있다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2019. 10. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Support for Reporting by Electronic Methods) ① Pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 6 of the Act, the Minister of Employment and Labor may, within the limits of the budget, provide the equipment specified in each of the following subparagraphs to employers, prime contractors, or subcontractors who intend to report matters concerning the acquisition or loss of insured status by electronic means. <Amended July 12, 2010; October 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 건설고용보험카드
rows.text_en: 1. Construction Employment Insurance Card

rows.source_ko: 2. 건설고용보험카드 판독기와 그 부대 물품
rows.text_en: 2. Construction Employment Insurance Card Reader and Ancillary Supplies

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 지원을 받으려는 자는 별지 제15호서식의 건설고용보험카드 발급 신청서와 별지 제16호서식의 건설고용보험카드 판독기 설치 신청서를 근로복지공단에 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2016. 11. 17., 2019. 10. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who wishes to receive support pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall submit the Application for Issuance of Construction Employment Insurance Card ( Form No. 15) and the Application for Installation of Construction Employment Insurance Card Reader (Form No. 16) to the Korea Workers' Welfare Service. <Amended Nov. 17, 2016; Oct. 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 신청을 받은 근로복지공단은 예산의 범위에서 해당 사업장의 규모 등을 고려하여 필요하다고 인정되는 장비 등을 지원할 수 있다. 이 경우 지원 대수와 지원방법 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 고용노동부장관이 정한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2016. 11. 17.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Korea Workers' Welfare Service may provide support for equipment, etc., deemed necessary within the limits of the budget, taking into consideration the scale, etc., of the relevant workplace. In this case, necessary matters concerning the number of units to be supported and the method of support, etc., shall be determined by the Minister of Employment and Labor. <Amended Jul. 12, 2010; Nov. 17, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(피보험자의 전근 신고) 영 제9조에 따른 피보험자의 전근신고는 별지 제17호서식의 피보험자 전근 신고서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Reporting of Transfer of Insured Person) The report of transfer of an insured person pursuant to Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Insured Person Transfer Report Form No. 17 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(전산입력자료에 따른 대체 신고 등) 제1조의2, 제1조의3, 제2조, 제2조의2, 제2조의3, 제5조부터 제9조까지, 제82조의2, 제125조의3 및 제125조의9에 따른 신고 및 제출은 별지 제18호서식의 전산입력자료 대체 신고서에 별지 제5호서식ㆍ별지 제5호의2서식ㆍ별지 제5호의3서식(농림어업근로자의 경우에는 별지 제1호서식, 별정직ㆍ임기제 공무원의 경우에는 별지 제1호의2서식, 외국인근로자등의 경우에는 별지 제1호의3서식, 외국인예술인ㆍ15세 미만 예술인의 경우에는 별지 제1호의4서식, 외국인노무제공자ㆍ15세 미만 노무제공자의 경우에는 별지 제1호의5서식, 일용근로자의 경우에는 별지 제7호서식, 단기예술인 및 단기노무제공자의 경우에는 별지 제7호의2서식을 포함한다), 별지 제6호서식ㆍ별지 제6호의2서식, 별지 제17호서식 및 별지 제75호의4서식의 내용이 포함된 전산입력 자료를 첨부하여 제출함으로써 해당 신고 및 제출을 대신할 수 있다. <개정 2024. 7. 1., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Substitute Reporting by Submission of Computerized Data, etc.) Reports and submissions under Articles 1-2, 1-3, 2, 2-2, 2-3, 5 through 9, 82-2, 125-3, and 125-9 may be made instead by submitting the substitute report using Attached Form No. 18 together with computerized data containing the information required by Attached Forms Nos. 5, 5-2, and 5-3 (including Attached Form No. 1 for agricultural, forestry, and fisheries workers; No. 1-2 for special-service and fixed-term public officials; No. 1-3 for foreign workers, etc.; No. 1-4 for foreign artists and artists under 15; No. 1-5 for foreign labor providers and labor providers under 15; No. 7 for daily workers; and No. 7-2 for short-term artists and short-term labor providers), Attached Forms Nos. 6 and 6-2, Attached Form No. 17, and Attached Form No. 75-4. <Amended Jul. 1, 2024; Jul. 1, 2026>
[Wholly Amended June 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(피보험자의 이름 등 변경신고) 영 제10조제1항에 따른 변경ㆍ정정신고 또는 같은 조 제2항에 따른 변경신고는 별지 제19호서식ㆍ별지 제19호의2서식의 고용보험 피보험자 내용 변경 신고서에 따른다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2012. 1. 20., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Reporting Change of Name, etc. of Insured Person) A report of change or correction pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, or a report of change pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article, shall be made using the Report on Change of Details of Employment Insurance Insured Person in Annex Form No. 19 or Annex Form No. 19-2. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; Jan. 20, 2012; July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(피보험자격의 확인청구) 영 제11조제1항에 따른 피보험자격의 취득이나 상실에 관한 확인청구는 별지 제20호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격확인 청구서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Request for Confirmation of Insured Status) A request to confirm the acquisition or loss of insured status under Article 11 (1) of the Decree shall be made using the Employment Insurance Insured Status Confirmation Request under Attached Form No. 20.

rows.source_ko: 제13조(피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실 확인통지) 근로복지공단은 영 제11조제2항에 따른 피보험자격의 취득이나 상실에 관한 확인통지를 하는 경우 별지 제21호서식과 별지 제22호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 취득ㆍ상실 확인통지서(일용근로자는 별지 제23호서식과 별지 제24호서식의 고용보험 피보험자격 확인통지서)에 따른다. <개정 2019. 2. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Notice of Confirmation of Acquisition or Loss of Insured Status) When the Korea Workers' Compensation and Welfare Service notifies a person of confirmation of the acquisition or loss of insured status under Article 11 (2) of the Decree, it shall use the notices under Attached Forms Nos. 21 and 22 (or Attached Forms Nos. 23 and 24 for daily workers). <Amended Feb. 12, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(자영업자의 피보험자격 취득ㆍ상실 기준) 법 제18조제3항에 따라 법 제2조제1호가목 및 나목에 동시에 해당하는 자영업자의 피보험자격의 취득ㆍ상실에 관하여는 법 제13조제2항 및 제14조제2항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Criteria for Acquisition and Loss of Insured Status of Self-Employed Persons) Pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Act, Article 13, Paragraph 2 and Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the acquisition and loss of insured status of a self-employed person who simultaneously falls under Article 2, Subparagraph 1, Items (a) and (b) of the Act.
[Wholly Amended June 30, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제3장 고용안정ㆍ직업능력개발사업
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Employment Stability and Vocational Competency Development Programs
Article 15 Deleted <September 16, 2011>
Article 16 Deleted <September 16, 2011>
Article 17 Deleted <January 3, 2011>
Article 18 Deleted <January 3, 2011>
Article 19 Deleted <January 3, 2011>
Article 20 Deleted <September 19, 2008>
Article 21 Deleted <September 19, 2008>
Article 22 Deleted <September 19, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제23조(하도급 사업주의 신고) 영 제18조제2항제2호에 해당하는 사업주가 영 제19조제1항에 따른 고용유지지원금을 받으려면 제31조에 따른 고용유지조치계획 신고서에 별지 제31호서식의 하도급 사업주 신고서와 하도급계약서 사본 등 하도급 계약기간을 확인할 수 있는 서류를 첨부하여 제출해야 한다. <개정 2013. 12. 30., 2023. 12. 29., 2026. 5. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Reporting by Subcontractor) In order for a business owner falling under Article 18, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree to receive employment retention subsidies pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, they must submit a report on the employment retention measure plan pursuant to Article 31, attaching the report on the subcontractor business owner in Annex 31 and documents verifying the subcontract period, such as a copy of the subcontract agreement. <Amended Dec. 30, 2013; Dec. 29, 2023; May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제24조(고용조정이 불가피하게 된 사업주) ① 영 제19조제1항과 영 제22조 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 고용조정이 불가피하게 된 사업주는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사업주로 한다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 1. 3., 2013. 1. 25., 2013. 4. 24., 2020. 12. 31., 2023. 12. 29., 2026. 5. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Employers for whom employment adjustment has become inevitable) ①An employer for whom employment adjustment has become inevitable pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree and the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree shall be an employer falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 12, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Jan. 25, 2013; Apr. 24, 2013; Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 29, 2023; May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제20조제1항에 따라 신고한 고용유지조치계획에 따라 실시하는 영 제19조제1항에 따른 고용유지조치(이하 “고용유지조치”라 한다)의 첫 날이 속하는 달의 직전 달(이하 이 조에서 “기준달”이라 한다)의 매출액이 기준달 직전 6개월의 월평균 매출액에 비하여 100분의 15 이상 감소한 사업의 사업주
rows.text_en: 1. An employer whose sales in the month immediately preceding the month containing the first day of employment retention measures under Article 19 (1) of the Decree implemented in accordance with the plan reported under Article 20 (1) of the Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “base month”) have decreased by at least 15 percent compared with the monthly average sales during the six months preceding the base month.

rows.source_ko: 2. 기준달의 매출액과 기준달 직전 6개월 중 연속한 3개월씩의 월평균 매출액이 계속 감소 추세에 있는 사업의 사업주
rows.text_en: 2. Business owners whose sales revenue in the reference month and the monthly average sales revenue for three consecutive months out of the six months immediately preceding the reference month are on a continuous downward trend.

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 업종, 지역경제 상황의 악화 등 고용노동부장관이 정하는 기준에 따라 고용조정이 불가피하다고 직업안정기관의 장이 인정한 사업의 사업주
rows.text_en: 3. Employers of businesses where the head of the employment security agency recognizes that employment adjustment is unavoidable in accordance with criteria set by the Minister of Employment and Labor, such as the relevant industry or the deterioration of regional economic conditions.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제1호에도 불구하고 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법」 제3조제1호에 따른 재난 등으로 급격히 악화된 고용사정이 6개월 이상 계속되는 경우에는 고용노동부장관은 매출액 감소를 비교하는 시점을 각각 달리 정하여 고시할 수 있다. <신설 2020. 12. 31., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, if employment conditions that have rapidly deteriorated due to a disaster, etc., pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management continue for six months or more, the Minister of Employment and Labor may determine and announce different time points for comparing the decrease in sales revenue, respectively. <Newly added Dec. 31, 2020; Dec. 29, 2023>
Article 25 Deleted <May 11, 2026>
Article 26 Deleted <April 24, 2013>
Article 27 Deleted <July 11, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제28조(고용유지지원금의 지급신청 방법) ① 영 제19조제1항에 따른 고용유지조치를 실시한 사업주가 고용유지지원금을 받으려면 별지 제32호서식의 고용유지지원금 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2026. 5. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Method of Applying for Employment Retention Subsidies) ①An employer who has implemented employment retention measures pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree and wishes to receive employment retention subsidies shall submit an application for employment retention subsidies in the form of Annex 32, attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the employment security agency having jurisdiction over the employer's location. <Amended May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 근로자의 월별 임금대장 사본 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the employee's monthly wage ledger

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용유지조치 기간 중 사업주가 임금을 보전하기 위하여 지급한 금품을 확인할 수 있는 자료 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of documents verifying money or valuables paid by the employer to compensate for wages during the employment retention period.

rows.source_ko: 3. 출퇴근카드 또는 출퇴근기록부 등 출퇴근 현황을 확인할 수 있는 서류 사본 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents verifying attendance status, such as a time card or attendance record.
4. Deleted <May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 사업주(법인인 경우 대표자를 말한다)의 주민등록표 등본 또는 가족관계등록전산정보를 확인해야 한다. 이 경우 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the employment security agency having jurisdiction over the location of the application received pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the resident registration certificate or computerized family relationship registration information of the employer (in the case of a corporation, the representative) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. In this case, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant must be required to attach such documents.
[Wholly Amended Dec. 29, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제29조(고용유지지원금의 지급신청 시기) 영 제19조제1항에 따른 고용유지조치를 실시한 사업주는 역(曆)에 따른 1개월을 단위로 해당 고용유지조치를 실시한 날이 속하는 달의 말일부터 3개월이 되는 날까지 고용유지지원금의 지급을 신청해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Time Limit for Applying for Employment Retention Subsidies) An employer who has implemented employment retention measures under Article 19 (1) of the Decree shall apply for an employment retention subsidy for each calendar-month period by the date falling three months after the last day of the month in which the measures were implemented.
[Wholly revised May 11, 2026]
Article 30 Deleted <April 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제31조(고용유지조치계획의 신고 등) ① 영 제20조제1항에 따라 고용유지조치계획을 신고하거나 변경신고하려는 사업주는 별지 제36호서식의 고용유지조치 계획ㆍ계획변경 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 1., 2009. 5. 28., 2011. 1. 3., 2013. 4. 24., 2013. 12. 30., 2020. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 12. 29., 2026. 5. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Reporting Employment Retention Measure Plans, etc.) ① An employer intending to file or amend an employment retention measure plan under Article 20 (1) of the Decree shall submit the notification of an employment retention measure plan or its amendment using Attached Form No. 36, together with the following documents, to the head of the employment security agency with jurisdiction over the workplace. <Amended Apr. 1, 2009; May 28, 2009; Jan. 3, 2011; Apr. 24, 2013; Dec. 30, 2013; Dec. 31, 2020; Jul. 1, 2021; Dec. 29, 2023; May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 매출액 장부, 매출처별 세금계산서 합계표, 손익계산서 또는 세금계산서 등 제24조에 따른 고용조정이 불가피함을 증명하는 서류 사본 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of documents proving that employment adjustment pursuant to Article 24 is unavoidable, such as sales ledgers, summary of tax invoices by customer, income statement, or tax invoices.

rows.source_ko: 2. 노사협의회 회의록, 대상자 명단, 노사협의서 또는 근로자대표 선임서 등 영 제20조제1항제1호에 따라 사업주가 근로자 대표와 협의하였음을 증명하는 서류 사본 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of documents proving that the employer consulted with the employee representative in accordance with Article 20, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, such as minutes of the Labor-Management Council meeting, a list of persons concerned, a labor -management agreement, or a letter of appointment for an employee representative.

rows.source_ko: 3. 취업규칙 또는 단체협약 등 사업장의 소정근로시간 기준을 확인할 수 있는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents verifying the workplace's prescribed working hours standards, such as employment rules or collective agreements.
4. Deleted <May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 5. 파견 또는 도급 관계에 있음을 증명할 수 있는 서류 1부(영 제19조제4항에 따라 파견사업주 또는 도급을 받은 사업주가 고용유지조치를 실시하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 5. One copy of documents proving a dispatch or contracting relationship ( applicable only when the dispatching employer or the contracting employer implements employment retention measures pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신고를 받은 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 부가가치세과세표준증명원 또는 부가가치세면세사업자수입금액증명을 확인해야 한다. 이 경우 신고인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <신설 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② On receiving the notification under paragraph 1, the head of the employment security agency with jurisdiction over the workplace shall verify a certificate of value-added tax base or a certificate of revenue of a VAT-exempt business operator through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act. If the reporting person does not consent to verification, the person shall be required to attach the relevant certificate. <Newly added Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제20조제1항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <신설 2013. 4. 24., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ③ In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Apr. 24, 2013; Dec. 29, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용유지조치 실시예정일
rows.text_en: 1. Scheduled date for implementation of employment retention measures

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용유지조치 대상자
rows.text_en: 2. Persons Subject to Employment Retention Measures

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용유지조치기간에 지급할 금품
rows.text_en: 3. Money and benefits to be paid during the employment retention period

rows.source_ko: 4. 고용유지조치의 내용
rows.text_en: 4. Details of Employment Retention Measures
Article 32 Deleted <December 30, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제32조의2(고용유지조치계획 위반에 대한 지원제한) 고용노동부장관은 영 제20조의2에 따라 사업주가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항을 신고하거나 변경신고한 고용유지조치계획과 다르게 이행한 경우, 고용유지조치계획보다 초과하여 이행한 사항에 대해서는 고용유지조치계획의 내용에 따라, 고용유지조치계획보다 미달하여 이행한 사항에 대해서는 실제 이행한 내용에 따라 각각 고용유지지원금을 산정ㆍ지급한다. 다만, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나를 고용유지조치계획보다 100분의 50 미만으로 이행한 경우에는 해당 달의 고용유지지원금의 전부를 지급하지 않는다. <개정 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 32-2 (Restrictions on Support Where an Employment Retention Measure Plan Is Not Followed) Where an employer implements any of the matters specified below differently from those reported in an employment retention measure plan or amendment thereto under Article 20-2 of the Decree, the Minister of Employment and Labor shall calculate and pay the subsidy for implementation in excess of the plan according to the plan, and for implementation below the planned level according to what was actually implemented. However, if any of the following matters is implemented at less than 50 percent of the planned level, no employment retention subsidy shall be paid for the relevant month. <Amended Jul. 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고용유지조치 대상자 수
rows.text_en: 1. Number of employees subject to employment retention measures

rows.source_ko: 2. 고용유지조치기간
rows.text_en: 2. Employment retention period

rows.source_ko: 3. 고용유지조치기간에 지급한 금품
rows.text_en: 3. Money and valuables paid during the employment retention period
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 24, 2013]
Article 33 Deleted <December 30, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제34조(피보험자 지원을 위한 고용안정 조치의 요건) ① 영 제21조의3제1항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 고용조정이 불가피하게 된 사유”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 12. 29., 2026. 5. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Requirements for Employment Stability Measures for Supporting Insured Persons) ① In the first part excluding the subparagraphs of Article 21-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “reasons for which employment adjustment has become inevitable as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” refers to any of the following cases: <Amended July 1, 2021; December 29, 2023; May 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제21조의3제4항에 따라 사업주가 고용유지조치계획을 수립하여 고용노동부장관에게 제출한 날이 속하는 달의 직전 달(이하 이 조에서 “기준달”이라 한다)의 매출액이 기준달 직전 6개월의 월평균 매출액에 비하여 100분의 30 이상 감소한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Where sales for the month immediately preceding the month in which an employer established and submitted an employment retention plan to the Minister of Employment and Labor under Article 21-3 (4) of the Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “base month”) decreased by at least 30 percent compared with the average monthly sales during the six months preceding that base month

rows.source_ko: 2. 기준달의 매출액과 기준달 직전 6개월 중 연속한 3개월씩의 월평균 매출액이 계속하여 각각 100분의 20 이상 감소한 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where sales for the base month and the successive three-month average sales figures for periods within the six months preceding the base month have each continuously decreased by at least 20 percent

rows.source_ko: 3. 해당 업종, 지역경제 상황의 악화 등 고용노동부장관이 정하는 기준에 따라 고용조정이 불가피하다고 직업안정기관의 장이 인정한 사업의 사업주
rows.text_en: 3. Employers of businesses where the head of the employment security agency recognizes that employment adjustment is unavoidable in accordance with criteria set by the Minister of Employment and Labor, such as the relevant industry or the deterioration of regional economic conditions.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항제1호에도 불구하고 「재난 및 안전관리 기본법」 제3조제1호에 따른 재난 등으로 급격히 악화된 고용사정이 6개월 이상 계속되는 경우 고용노동부장관은 매출액 감소를 비교하는 시점을 각각 달리 정하여 고시할 수 있다. <신설 2021. 7. 1., 2023. 12. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, in cases where employment conditions that have rapidly deteriorated due to a disaster, etc., pursuant to Article 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management continue for six months or more, the Minister of Employment and Labor may determine and announce different time points for comparing the decrease in sales revenue, respectively. <Newly added July 1, 2021; December 29, 2023>

[This Article newly established on Apr. 24, 2013]
[Title amended on May 11, 2026]
Article 35 Deleted <January 3, 2011>
Article 36 Deleted <January 3, 2011>
Article 37 Deleted <September 19, 2008>
Article 38 Deleted <September 19, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 제39조(지역고용계획의 신고) 영 제24조제1항제1호에 따라 지역고용계획을 신고하려는 사업주는 별지 제44호서식의 지역고용계획 신고서를 이전되거나 신설 또는 증설된 사업의 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. 신고한 사항을 변경하려는 경우에는 조업시작 예정일 10일 전까지 별지 제44호서식의 지역고용계획변경 신고서를 같은 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 39 (Reporting of Regional Employment Plan) An employer who intends to report a regional employment plan pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a Regional Employment Plan Report (Form No. 44) to the head of the employment security agency having jurisdiction over the location of the business that has been relocated, newly established, or expanded. If the reported matters are to be changed, a Regional Employment Plan Change Report (Form No. 44) shall be submitted to the head of the same employment security agency at least 10 days prior to the scheduled start date of operations. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; July 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제40조(조업시작의 신고) 영 제24조제2항에 따라 조업시작을 신고하려는 사업주는 별지 제45호서식의 지역고용 조업시작 신고서를 이전, 신설 또는 증설된 사업의 조업이 시작된 날(이하 “조업시작일”이라 한다)부터 1개월 이내에 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Reporting of Commencement of Operations) An employer who intends to report the commencement of operations pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the Regional Employment Commencement of Operation Report ( Form No. 45 ) to the head of the employment security agency having jurisdiction over the location within one month from the date on which operations of the relocated, newly established, or expanded business commence (hereinafter referred to as the “date of commencement of operations”). <Amended Jan. 3, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제41조(지역고용촉진 지원금의 신청) ① 영 제24조에 따라 지역고용촉진 지원금을 지급받으려는 사업주는 별지 제46호서식의 지역고용촉진 지원금 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 조업시작일이 속한 달의 다음 달부터 3개월마다 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 영 제24조제1항제4호에 따라 고용된 피보험자(이하 이 조 및 제41조의2에서 “근로자”라 한다)의 주민등록표 초본을 확인해야 하며, 근로자가 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 이를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2018. 5. 8., 2020. 8. 28., 2022. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 41 (Application for Regional Employment Promotion Subsidies) ① An employer wishing to receive a regional employment promotion subsidy under Article 24 of the Decree shall submit an application using Attached Form No. 46, together with the following documents, to the head of the competent employment security agency every three months beginning with the month after the month in which operations commenced. The head of the employment security agency shall verify an abstract of resident registration for each insured worker hired under Article 24 (1) 4 of the Decree (hereinafter referred to as a “worker” in this Article and Article 41-2) through the joint use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act; where a worker does not consent to verification, the worker shall be required to attach the document. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; May 8, 2018; Aug. 28, 2020; Jun. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 근로자의 월별 임금대장 사본 및 임금지급을 증명할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Copies of the employee's monthly wage ledger and documents proving wage payment

rows.source_ko: 2. 근로계약서 사본
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of employment contract

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항의 지역고용촉진 지원금 지급 신청 기간은 해당 사업주의 조업시작일부터 1년 6개월 이내로 한다. <신설 2022. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The application period for the payment of regional employment promotion subsidies under Paragraph 1 shall be within 1 year and 6 months from the start date of operations of the relevant employer. <Newly added Jun. 30, 2022>
Article 41-2 Deleted <June 30, 2022>
Article 42 Deleted <December 31, 2024>
Article 43 Deleted <December 31, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제44조(고용촉진장려금의 지급요건) ① 영 제26조제1항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 기관”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기관으로서 「직업안정법」에 따른 직업소개를 직접 수행하는 기관을 말한다. <개정 2008. 12. 31., 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 1. 3., 2011. 12. 30., 2013. 1. 25., 2021. 7. 1., 2022. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 44 (Requirements for Payment of Employment Promotion Incentives) ①In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “institution prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” refers to an institution falling under any of the following subparagraphs that directly performs job placement services pursuant to the Job Security Act. <Amended Dec. 31, 2008; Jul. 12, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Dec. 30, 2011; Jan. 25, 2013; Jul. 1, 2021; Jun. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 직업안정기관 외의 국가나 지방자치단체
rows.text_en: 1. State or local governments other than employment security agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 「한국산업인력공단법」에 따른 한국산업인력공단(이하 “공단”이라 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. The Korea Human Resources Development Service pursuant to the Korea Human Resources Development Service Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Service”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법」에 따른 한국장애인고용공단 및 같은 법 제16조의 취업알선전산망을 통하여 취업알선업무를 수행하는 같은 법 제9조제2항에 따른 장애인 직업재활 실시 기관
rows.text_en: 3. The Korea Employment Agency for Persons with Disabilities pursuant to the Act on Promotion of Employment and Vocational Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities, and vocational rehabilitation institutions for persons with disabilities pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the same Act that perform employment placement duties through the computerized employment placement network under Article 16 of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: 4. 「고용상 연령차별금지 및 고령자고용촉진에 관한 법률」 제11조에 따른 고령자인재은행 또는 같은 법 제11조의2에 따른 중견전문인력 고용지원센터
rows.text_en: 4. Senior Talent Bank pursuant to Article 11 of the Act on the Prohibition of Age Discrimination in Employment and Promotion of Employment of Older Persons or Employment Support Center for Mid-career Professionals pursuant to Article 11-2 of the same Act
5. Deleted <Jan. 3, 2011>

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제26조제1항제3호에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 사람”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람을 말한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In Article 26, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “person prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” refers to a person falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 배우자가 없는 여성으로서 본인과 배우자였던 사람의 60세 이상의 직계존속(직계존속이 여성인 경우에는 55세 이상으로 한다)이나 18세 미만의 직계비속을 부양하고 있는 사람. 이 경우 그 직계존속이나 직계비속이 주민등록표상 세대를 같이 하는 경우만 해당한다.
rows.text_en: 1. A woman without a spouse who is supporting a lineal ascendant aged 60 or older (or 55 or older if the lineal ascendant is female) or a lineal descendant under the age of 18 of herself or her former spouse. In this case, this applies only if the lineal ascendant or lineal descendant shares the same household on the resident registration record.

rows.source_ko: 2. 근로능력이 없는 배우자(주민등록표상 세대를 같이 하는 경우만 해당한다)를 부양하고 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. A person supporting a spouse who is unable to work (only applicable if they share the same household on the resident registration record).

rows.source_ko: 3. 배우자가 없는 여성으로서 본인과 배우자였던 사람의 직계존속ㆍ직계비속이나 형제ㆍ자매 중 근로능력이 없는 사람(주민등록표상 세대를 같이 하는 사람만 해당한다)를 부양하고 있는 사람
rows.text_en: 3. A woman without a spouse who is supporting a person unable to work among her or her former spouse's lineal ascendants, lineal descendants, or siblings (limited to those sharing the same household on the resident registration record).

③ In Article 26, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “person falling under cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor, such as cases where the employment contract period is short-term” refers to a worker falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 9, 2010; Jul. 12, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Sep. 16, 2011; Jan. 25, 2013; Dec. 30, 2013; Dec. 30, 2016; Jun. 28, 2017; Jul. 11, 2018; Dec. 31, 2018; Jun. 30, 2022; Dec. 9, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 근로계약 기간을 정한 근로자. 다만, 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우는 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 1. An employee with a fixed-term employment contract. However, cases falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall be excluded.

rows.source_ko: 가. 사업의 완료 또는 특정한 업무의 완성에 필요한 기간을 정한 경우로서 근로계약기간이 2년을 초과하는 경우
rows.text_en: a. Cases where the employment contract period exceeds two years, provided that a period necessary for the completion of a project or specific task has been set.

rows.source_ko: 나. 휴직ㆍ파견 등으로 결원이 발생하여 그 근로자가 복귀할 때까지 그 업무를 대신할 필요가 있는 경우로서 근로계약기간이 2년을 초과하는 경우
rows.text_en: B. Cases where a vacancy occurs due to leave of absence, dispatch, etc., and it is necessary to fill in for the employee until their return, and the employment contract period exceeds two years.
C. Deleted <Jan. 25, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 라. 그 밖에 노동시장의 통상적인 조건에서는 취업이 특히 곤란한 사람의 취업촉진을 위하여 사업주가 근로계약 기간을 정하여 고용하더라도 지원이 필요하다고 고용노동부장관이 인정하여 고시한 경우로서 근로계약기간이 1년 이상인 경우
rows.text_en: (d) Other cases where the Minister of Employment and Labor recognizes and notifies that support is necessary to promote the employment of persons who would find it particularly difficult to find employment under ordinary labor market conditions, even if the employer hires them for a fixed term, and the employment contract period is one year or more.
2. Deleted <June 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 3. 「최저임금법」 제5조에 따른 최저임금액 등을 고려하여 고용노동부장관이 정하여 고시하는 보수 기준 미만인 근로자
rows.text_en: 3. Workers whose wages are less than the standard remuneration determined and notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor in consideration of the minimum wage amount, etc., pursuant to Article 5 of the Minimum Wage Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 사업주의 배우자 및 직계존속ㆍ비속
rows.text_en: 4. Spouse and lineal ascendants and descendants of the employer

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제26조제3항제6호에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2008. 9. 19., 2010. 2. 9., 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 1. 3., 2013. 1. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ In Article 26, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree, the phrase “cases prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” means any of the following cases: <Amended Sep. 19, 2008; Feb. 9, 2010; Jul. 12, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Jan. 25, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 이직 전 사업이 인수ㆍ합병ㆍ분할된 경우에는 인수ㆍ합병ㆍ분할된 사업의 사업주인 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where the business prior to leaving employment was acquired, merged, or split, if the employer is the owner of the acquired, merged, or split business

rows.source_ko: 2. 이직 전 사업의 사업주와 다른 사업의 사업주가 어느 한 쪽의 발행주식이나 출자지분의 100분의 30 이상을 소유하고 있는 관계에 있는 경우에는 그 다른 사업의 사업주인 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where the employer of the former business and the employer of another business are related in such a way that either employer holds at least 30 percent of the issued shares or equity of the other employer, the employer of the other business

rows.source_ko: 3. 이직 전 사업의 시설ㆍ설비나 그 임차권을 유상이나 무상으로 양도받은 사업주인 경우
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of an employer who has acquired the facilities, equipment, or leasehold rights of the business prior to leaving employment, whether for consideration or free of charge.

rows.source_ko: 4. 이직 전 사업과 자본ㆍ자금ㆍ인사ㆍ사업의 내용에서 밀접한 관계가 있는 등 양 사업 간에 실질적인 동일성이 인정되는 사업의 사업주인 경우
rows.text_en: 4. In the case of being the owner of a business where substantial identity is recognized between the two businesses, such as through a close relationship with the previous business in terms of capital, funds, personnel, or business content.

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 이직 전 사업주와 밀접한 관련성이 있다고 인정되는 사업주인 경우
rows.text_en: 5. In other cases where the employer is recognized as having a close relationship with the previous employer.
⑤ Deleted <Jan. 3, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제45조(고용촉진장려금의 신청) ① 영 제26조제1항에 따라 고용촉진장려금을 지급받으려는 사업주는 고용노동부장관이 정하여 고시하는 고용촉진장려금 지급 신청서를 새로 근로자를 고용한 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달부터 6개월마다 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2008. 4. 30., 2008. 9. 19., 2009. 5. 28., 2010. 2. 9., 2011. 1. 3., 2012. 1. 20., 2013. 1. 25., 2016. 12. 30., 2022. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 45 (Application for Employment Promotion Incentives) ① An employer seeking employment promotion incentives under Article 26 (1) of the Decree shall submit the application prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor to the head of the employment security agency with jurisdiction over the workplace every six months starting in the month following the month in which the employee was newly hired. <Amended Apr. 30, 2008; Sep. 19, 2008; May 28, 2009; Feb. 9, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Jan. 20, 2012; Jan. 25, 2013; Dec. 30, 2016; Jun. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 사업주가 제1항에 따른 신청서를 제출할 때에는 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부해야 한다. 이 경우 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 주민등록표 등본을 확인해야 하며, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 주민등록표 등본을 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <신설 2012. 1. 20., 2022. 6. 30., 2022. 12. 9.>
rows.text_en: ② When an employer submits an application pursuant to Paragraph 1, they must attach the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the head of the employment security agency having jurisdiction over the location shall verify the certified copy of the resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach a certified copy of the resident registration record. <Newly added Jan. 20, 2012; Jun. 30, 2022; Dec. 9, 2022>

2. Deleted <December 9, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 3. 새로 고용한 근로자가 중증장애인임을 증명하는 서류 1부(영 제26조제1항제2호에 해당하는 사람을 고용하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of documents proving that the newly hired worker is a person with a severe disability ( applicable only to cases where a person falling under Article 26, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is hired)

rows.source_ko: 4. 새로 고용한 근로자의 가족관계증명서 및 해당 근로자가 가족부양의 책임이 있음을 증명하는 서류(영 제26조제1항제3호에 해당하는 사람을 고용하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 4. Family relationship certificate of the newly hired worker and documents proving that the worker has responsibility for family support ( applicable only to cases where a person falling under Article 26, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is hired)

rows.source_ko: 5. 「한부모가족지원법 시행규칙」 제3조의3에 따른 한부모가족증명서 1부(영 제26조제1항제3호에 해당하는 사람 중 「한부모가족지원법」에 따른 보호대상자를 고용한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 5. One copy of a Single-Parent Family Certificate pursuant to Article 3-3 of the Enforcement Rule of the Single-Parent Family Support Act (applicable only in cases where a person eligible for protection under the Single-Parent Family Support Act is employed among those falling under Article 26, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree)

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항의 고용촉진장려금 지급 신청 기간은 해당 사업주가 새로 근로자를 고용한 날부터 1년 6개월 이내로 한다. <신설 2022. 6. 30., 2026. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The application period for the Employment Promotion Incentive under Paragraph 1 shall be within one year and six months from the date the relevant employer hires a new worker. <Newly added Jun. 30, 2022; Jul. 1, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④ 직업안정기관의 장은 신규고용 대상자의 구직등록이나 알선과정에서 신규고용 대상자와 사업주에게 고용촉진장려금의 지급대상 여부 및 지급기준 등에 관한 사항을 알려주어야 한다. <신설 2008. 4. 30., 2011. 1. 3., 2016. 12. 30., 2022. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ The head of the employment security agency shall notify the prospective new hire and the employer of matters concerning eligibility for employment promotion incentives and payment criteria, etc., during the process of job registration or placement. <Newly added Apr. 30, 2008; Jan. 3, 2011; Dec. 30, 2016; Jun. 30, 2022>
[Title amended Dec. 30, 2016]

rows.source_ko: 제49조(임금피크제 지원금 등의 금액 산정) 영 제28조제2항 및 제28조의2제2항에 따른 피크임금과 해당 연도 임금과의 차액 산정은 「소득세법」 제20조제1항에 따른 근로소득(같은 법 제12조제3호에 따른 비과세소득은 제외한다)을 기준으로 하되, 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사유로 임금이 낮아진 경우에는 영 제28조제2항 또는 제28조의2제2항에 따른 임금의 감액으로 보지 않는다. <개정 2010. 7. 12., 2011. 1. 3., 2015. 12. 7., 2018. 12. 31., 2021. 7. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 49 (Calculation of Amount for Wage Peak System Subsidies, etc.) The calculation of the difference between the peak wage and the wage for the relevant year pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 2 and Article 28-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be based on earned income pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Income Tax Act (excluding non-taxable income pursuant to Article 12, Subparagraph 3 of the same Act ); provided, however, that a reduction in wages due to any of the reasons falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall not be deemed a reduction in wages pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 2 or Article 28-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended July 12, 2010; Jan. 3, 2011; Dec. 7, 2015; Dec. 31, 2018; July 1, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 징계처분 등 근로자의 귀책사유
rows.text_en: 1. Causes attributable to the employee, such as disciplinary action

rows.source_ko: 2. 질병이나 부상
rows.text_en: 2. Illness or injury

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업장의 휴업
rows.text_en: 3. Suspension of business
4. Deleted <September 19, 2008>

rows.source_ko: 5. 쟁의행위
rows.text_en: 5. Industrial Action

rows.text_en: 6. Grounds equivalent to Subparagraphs 1 through 5, as determined and notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor
[Title amended Dec. 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제50조(임금피크제 지원금의 신청) ① 영 제28조에 따라 임금피크제 지원금을 지급받으려는 근로자는 별지 제52호서식의 임금피크제 지원금 신청서에, 임금피크제 지원금을 지급받으려는 사업주는 별지 제52호의2서식의 임금피크제 지원금 신청서(근로시간단축 사업주 지원)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 모두 첨부하여 다음 연도 1월 말일까지(해당 연도 중에 분기별 또는 월별로 지급받으려는 경우에는 각각 매분기 또는 매월 다음 달 말일까지) 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 제1호의 서류는 최초로 신청하는 경우에만 첨부한다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2012. 1. 20., 2013. 1. 25., 2014. 6. 17., 2014. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 50 (Application for Wage Peak System Subsidies) ① An employee seeking subsidies under Article 28 of the Decree shall submit an application using Attached Form No. 52, while an employer seeking subsidies to support reduced working hours shall submit an application using Attached Form No. 52-2. Each applicant shall attach all the following documents and submit the application to the head of the competent employment security agency by the end of January of the following year, or, if applying for quarterly or monthly payments during the relevant year, by the end of the month following the relevant quarter or month. The document under subparagraph 1 need only be attached to the first application. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; Jan. 20, 2012; Jan. 25, 2013; Jun. 17, 2014; Dec. 31, 2014>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제28조제1항에 따른 임금피크제를 적용받는 근로자에 해당함을 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of a document proving that the worker is subject to the wage peak system pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제28조제2항에 따른 피크임금과 해당 연도의 임금을 비교하여 임금이 같은 항 각 호의 구분에 따른 비율 이상 낮아진 사실을 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of a document proving, by comparing the peak wage under Article 28 (2) of the Decree with the wage for the relevant year, that wages decreased by at least the rate specified for the applicable category under that paragraph

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 임금피크제 지원금 중 근로자에게 지급하는 지원금은 사업주가 근로자를 대신하여 신청할 수 있다. <개정 2011. 1. 3., 2014. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② Among the wage peak system subsidies under Paragraph 1, the employer may apply for the subsidies paid to employees on behalf of the employee. <Amended Jan. 3, 2011; Dec. 31, 2014>
[Title amended Jan. 3, 2011]

rows.source_ko: 제50조의2(정년을 60세 이상으로 정한 사업 또는 사업장에서의 임금 감액에 따른 지원금의 신청) ① 영 제28조의2에 따라 지원금을 지급받으려는 근로자는 별지 제52호의3서식의 임금피크제 지원금 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 다음 연도 1월 말일까지(해당 연도 중에 분기별 또는 월별로 지급받으려는 경우에는 각각 매분기 또는 해당 월의 다음 달 말일까지) 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 제1호의 서류는 최초로 신청하는 경우에만 첨부한다.
rows.text_en: Article 50-2 (Applications for Subsidies for Wage Reductions in Businesses or Workplaces with a Retirement Age of 60 or Above) ① A worker seeking a subsidy under Article 28-2 of the Decree shall submit an application using Attached Form No. 52-3, together with all the following documents, to the head of the employment security agency with jurisdiction over the workplace by the end of January of the following year. If seeking payment quarterly or monthly during the relevant year, the worker shall submit the application by the end of the month following the relevant quarter or month. The document under subparagraph 1 need only be attached to the first application.

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제28조의2제1항에 따른 임금피크제를 적용받는 근로자에 해당함을 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of a document proving that the worker is subject to the wage peak system pursuant to Article 28-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제28조의2제2항에 따른 피크임금과 해당 연도의 임금을 비교하여 임금이 100분의 10 이상 낮아진 사실을 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of a document proving that the wage has decreased by 10% or more when comparing the peak wage pursuant to Article 28-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree with the wage for the relevant year.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 지원금은 사업주가 근로자를 대신하여 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The employer may apply for the subsidy under Paragraph 1 on behalf of the employee.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 7, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제50조의3(고령자 고용지원금 지원 기준) 영 제28조의5제1항에서 “고용노동부령으로 정하는 기준 이상으로 고용하는 사업주”란 해당 사업에서 매 분기 고용하고 있는 60세 이상인 월평균 근로자 수가 지원금 최초 산정일이 속한 분기의 직전 분기 마지막 날 이전 3년 동안의 60세 이상인 월평균 근로자 수 이상으로 고용하는 사업주를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 50-3 (Criteria for Subsidies for Employing Older Workers) The term “an employer employing workers at or above the level prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Employment and Labor” in Article 28-5 (1) of the Decree means an employer whose average monthly number of workers aged 60 or older employed in each quarter of the business is at least the average monthly number of workers aged 60 or older employed during the three years preceding the last day of the quarter immediately before the quarter containing the subsidy’s first calculation date.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제51조(출산육아기 고용안정장려금의 신청) ① 영 제29조에 따라 출산육아기 고용안정장려금을 지급받으려는 사업주는 고용노동부장관이 정하여 고시하는 고용안정장려금 지급 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 소재지 관할 직업안정기관의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2012. 1. 20., 2013. 1. 25., 2013. 12. 30., 2014. 9. 30., 2016. 12. 30., 2024. 7. 1., 2024. 12. 31., 2025. 12. 31., 2026. 7. 1., 2026. 8. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 51 (Application for Employment Stability Incentives for Childbirth and Childcare) ① An employer wishing to receive an employment stability incentive for childbirth and childcare under Article 29 of the Decree shall submit an application in the form prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Employment and Labor, together with the documents specified in the following subparagraphs, to the head of the employment security agency with jurisdiction over the workplace. <Amended Jan. 20, 2012; Jan. 25, 2013; Dec. 30, 2013; Sep. 30, 2014; Dec. 30, 2016; Jul. 1, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024; Dec. 31, 2025; Jul. 1, 2026; Aug. 19, 2026>
1. Deleted <December 31, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제29조제1항제2호에 해당하는 경우: 피보험자의 「남녀고용평등과 일ㆍ가정 양립 지원에 관한 법률」 제19조에 따른 육아휴직 또는 같은 법 제19조의2에 따른 육아기 근로시간 단축(이하 “육아휴직등”이라 한다) 실시를 증명하는 서류 사본 1부

Cases falling under Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree: One copy of documents proving the implementation of parental leave pursuant to Article 19 of the Act on Equal Employment Opportunities for Men and Women and Support for Work-Family Balance or reduction of working hours during the childcare period pursuant to Article 19-2 of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as “parental leave, etc.”).

rows.source_ko: 2의2. 영 제29조제1항제3호에 해당하는 경우: 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 2-2. Cases falling under Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree: The documents of each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 피보험자의 「근로기준법」 제74조제1항에 따른 출산전후휴가(이하 “출산전후휴가”라 한다), 같은 조 제3항에 따른 유산ㆍ사산 휴가(이하 “유산ㆍ사산휴가”라 한다) 또는 육아휴직등 실시를 증명하는 서류 사본 1부

One copy of documents proving the implementation of the insured's maternity leave pursuant to Article 74, Paragraph 1 of the Labor Standards Act (hereinafter referred to as “maternity leave”), miscarriage or stillbirth leave pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article (hereinafter referred to as “miscarriage or stillbirth leave”), or parental leave, etc.

rows.source_ko: 나. 대체인력으로 고용한 근로자의 근로계약서 사본과 월별 임금대장 사본 각 1부(대체인력을 고용한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: B. One copy each of the employment contract and monthly wage ledger for the worker hired as replacement personnel (applicable only when hiring replacement personnel)

rows.source_ko: 다. 대체인력으로 사용한 파견근로자의 근로자파견계약서 사본과 근로자파견의 대가 지급내역 사본 각 1부(파견근로자를 대체인력으로 사용한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: C. One copy each of the worker dispatch contract and the payment details for the worker dispatch used as replacement personnel (applicable only when a dispatched worker is used as replacement personnel)

rows.source_ko: 3. 영 제29조제1항제4호에 해당하는 경우: 다음 각 목의 서류

rows.source_ko: 다. 육아휴직등 또는 배우자 출산전후휴가를 사용한 근로자의 업무를 대신하여 수행할 근로자(이하 이 조 및 제52조에서 “업무분담자”라 한다)에게 업무분담에 대한 금전적 지원을 하였음을 증명하는 서류 사본 1부
rows.text_en: C. One copy of a document proving that financial support for the division of duties has been provided to the employee who will perform the duties of the employee using parental leave, etc. or spousal maternity leave (hereinafter referred to as the “duty sharer” in this Article and Article 52 ).

② The employment stability incentive for childbirth and childcare under Paragraph 1 shall be applied for in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 31, 2020; Dec. 31, 2021; Jul. 1, 2024; Dec. 31, 2024; Dec. 31, 2025; Jul. 1, 2026; Aug. 19, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제29조제1항제2호에 해당하는 경우: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따라 신청한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Cases falling under Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree: Applications shall be made in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 가. 영 제29조제3항에 따라 산정한 금액의 100분의 50에 해당하는 금액: 육아휴직등을 시작한 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달부터 3개월마다 신청
rows.text_en: a. An amount equivalent to 50% of the amount calculated pursuant to Article 29, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree: Application every three months starting from the month following the month in which the parental leave, etc. began.

rows.source_ko: 나. 영 제29조제3항에 따라 산정한 금액 중 가목에 해당하는 금액을 제외한 나머지 금액: 육아휴직등이 끝난 후 6개월이 지난 날부터 한꺼번에 신청. 다만, 사업주가 해당 근로자의 자기 사정으로 인하여 6개월 이상 계속 고용하지 못한 경우에는 해당 근로자가 이직한 날의 다음 날부터 한꺼번에 신청한다.
rows.text_en: b. The remaining amount after deducting the amount under item (a) from the amount calculated under Article 29 (3) of the Decree: A lump-sum application from the date six months have elapsed after the end of parental leave, etc. If the employer could not continue employing the worker for at least six months due to the worker’s personal circumstances, a lump-sum application may be made from the day after the worker leaves the job.

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제29조제1항제3호에 해당하는 경우: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따라 신청한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Cases falling under Article 29, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree: Applications shall be made in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 가. 영 제29조제6항제2호가목에 해당하는 금액: 출산전후휴가, 유산ㆍ사산휴가 또는 육아휴직등을 시작한 후 30일이 지난 날부터 신청
rows.text_en: a. Amount corresponding to Article 29, Paragraph 6, Subparagraph 2, Item (a) of the Enforcement Decree: Application made from the day 30 days have passed since the commencement of maternity leave, miscarriage or stillbirth leave, or parental leave, etc.

rows.source_ko: 나. 영 제29조제6항제2호나목에 해당하는 금액: 출산전후휴가, 유산ㆍ사산휴가 또는 육아휴직등을 시작한 날이 속하는 달의 다음 달부터 3개월마다 신청
